title: Radon Mitigation Fan Failure Proxy
app: Raspberry Shake, Safecast, Blitzortung-compatible lightning sensors, AirGradient CO2 sensors, radon monitors, allsky cameras, and magnetometers streamed to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=radon:reading
| stats latest(fan_rpm) as fan_rpm, latest(radon_bqm3) as radon_bqm3 by zone
| where fan_rpm=0 AND radon_bqm3>150
| sort - radon_bqm3
description: Uses Radon mitigation telemetry telemetry to monitor whether rising radon is happening while the mitigation fan appears stopped in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for fan failures before they become a long exposure window, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Radon mitigation telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Zone table of fan RPM and radon level.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges whether rising radon is happening while the mitigation fan appears stopped so you can spot fan failures before they become a long exposure window before it becomes annoying.
